summary: SPK RC 48 sua loi dang nhap tren NAS: sau khi nhap OTP (hoac dang nhap thuong) man hinh nhay 1 cai roi quay lai trang dang nhap.
changes: Sua loi cookie phien bi rot khi truy cap qua http trong LAN: truoc day neu publicUrl cau hinh dang https, server luon dat cookie co co Secure, nen trinh duyet vut cookie khi ban mo app bang http://nas:port — dang nhap tra ve thanh cong (app nhay 1 cai) roi request /projects ngay sau khong co cookie -> 401 -> quay ve trang dang nhap.

Cookie phien gio quyet dinh co Secure theo tung request dua vao ket noi that (x-forwarded-proto tu reverse proxy DSM, hoac socket TLS truc tiep): truy cap qua https van Secure dung chuan, truy cap qua http trong LAN thi khong Secure nen dang nhap hoat dong binh thuong.
Them test cho isSecureRequest va cookieSetHeader (https vs http, co/khong reverse proxy).
